type: hyperparameter_tuner
base_model, strategy,

raw train / test / optional validation rows;

kept aside; never used

grid, random: Skyulf's own fold loop
halving_grid, halving_random: sklearn halving
optuna: OptunaSearchCV (tuning extra)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="190" width="420" height="84" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d_val" value="Validation

fit on the train rows,
score on the validation rows" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="335" width="220" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_cv" value="CV folds by cv_type
k_fold, stratified_k_fold,
shuffle_split,
time_series_split, group folds;
cv_enabled=False: 20% holdout" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="330" width="220" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_fold" value="3. Inside every fold
the post-split steps are refit on the fold's train rows
and applied to its held-out rows; the model with
the candidate params is fit and scored" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="480" width="420" height="84" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_best" value="4. Best params
the candidate with the best score (TuningResult)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="614" width="420" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n_nested" value="cv_type = nested_cv
outer folds only evaluate:
each runs its own inner search;
a separate search over all
training rows picks the model" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="600" width="220" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_refit" value="5. Final refit on the full training split
preprocessing fit once on all training rows,
then the model with the best params;
this chain is what predict() uses" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="724" width="420" height="84" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_eval" value="6. Evaluation
test rows (and validation rows) are transformed

raw train / test / optional validation rows;
later steps become a recipe refit per fold

and applied to its held-out rows; the model with
the candidate params is fit and scored

g.text: each runs its own inner search;

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(234, 247, 238), rgb(20, 31, 24)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

g.text: 5. Final refit on the full training split
preprocessing fit once on all training rows,
then the model with the best params;
this chain is what predict() uses

by the final chain and scored once
